title: fix: recover CUA recording after resource setup failures
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes CUA recording retries and execution close staying broken after a temporary resource-directory initialization failure.

## User Impact

Once the filesystem problem is repaired, the same computer execution can retry recording, or close and allow a fresh execution. The failed action reports its original error and never reaches the native driver.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing resource owner keeps a rejected initialization promise indefinitely. Clear that promise only when its producer fails; successful resources keep their existing lifetime and cleanup behavior. No new state, shared abstraction, SDK, configuration or storage contract is added. A late initialization failure can already leave an empty directory; this repair does not expand that pre-existing cleanup policy.

## Evidence

- Frozen base `ab4bd26898483f42b2dd7615dc7c8004da79609b`; signed head `818ad4c3e2dee9a01e85a7f87fdf9fea9c73c23d`.
- Two deterministic regressions enter through registered `computer.act`, use real safe filesystem operations and existing synthetic native-driver fixtures. The resource root starts as a file, then is repaired to a directory. On the base, retry and close still rethrow the first failure. With the repair, recording retry works, close succeeds and a new execution is admitted. No production test seam or actual desktop recording.
- Strengthened regression red: 2/2 fail for the cached filesystem error, 9.56 seconds wall /6.18 seconds Vitest. Final green: 2/2, 45.96/40.84 seconds including compiler rebuild, under the same 5-second test deadline. Earlier selected green: 8.66/5.70 seconds.
- CUA plugin lane: 127 passed, four skipped across 13 files (59.07 seconds wall /53.43 seconds Vitest). Targeted production/test types, changed-file lint, format, whitespace and privacy checks pass.
- Independent precommit review clean; author simplification complete. Complete committed-range local ClawSweeper review of the exact signed head is clean, high confidence, with security cleared.
- Production growth: five net lines. Registered-boundary regression: 69 lines, fully funded by its own 69-line allocation; shared budget unchanged. Broad proof belongs to PR CI. No live Gateway, desktop or model mutation.

## CI attribution

[CI attempt1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41662476106) is **failed**, not green. Actual tested merge `a698f11041a7877ac3fd30221acdeaa2e72fbef6` has an unchanged UI test spreading a `Navigator` instance and an unchanged 61-line test-budget deficit. This PR adds 69 test lines and 69 credits; its positive delta exposes inherited debt because the checker treats nonpositive deltas differently. This does not claim an identical failing baseline checker. Other ratchet checks passed. Focused proof and reviews pass; landing uses native attributed inherited-failure admission with review and security gates preserved.
